note: Danske Bank's price book (updated 7 October 2026): at the standard price a Danske Konto (any number, with internet and mobile banking) costs 35 kroner a month, charged quarterly (105 a quarter). Customers aged 18 to 35 get the Danske Hverdag+ package, which includes the account, at 0 kroner, so the game waives the fee under 36. Read again 2026-10-30 (Visa/Dankort at the standard price): withdrawals at Danske Bank machines free, at another bank's Dankort machine 12 kroner, abroad 30 kroner plus the currency charge (1.5% outside the EU/EEA, Britain and Switzerland, 0.5% in their currencies; 1.5% written); a transfer online to someone else's account 5 kroner. The card is 269 kroner a year at the standard price; whether the Danske Hverdag+ package for 18 to 35 includes it wasn't settled from the price book, so no card fee is written. Not stated: overdraft, a returned payment, interest, transfers abroad (a separate price list), what opening asks.
